ev.q: Set in the Second Battle of Fallujah of the Iraq War
an upcoming tactical first-person shooter video game
A hallmark of the game is its emphasis on authentic squad tactics
the primary focus is on tension, surprise, and the unpredictability of urban combat
The player can issue commands to team members
Gameplay demands slow, deliberate movement, room-clearing tactics, team coordination, and awareness of enemy concealment
players can play solo (accompanied by AI teammates)
ray-traced lighting via RTX Global Illumination
